original: nanu yadi priyamapyaśarīraṃ na spṛśatīti, yanmaghavatoktaṃ suṣuptastho vināśamevāpīto bhavatīti, tadevehāpyāpannam. naiṣa doṣaḥ, dharmādharmakāryayoḥ śarīrasaṃbandhinoḥ priyāpriyayoḥ pratiṣedhasya vivakṣitatvāt -- aśarīraṃ na priyāpriye spṛśata iti.

original: nanu bhūmnaḥ priyasya ekatve asaṃvedyatvāt svarūpeṇaiva vā nityasaṃvedyatvāt nirviśeṣateti na indrasya tadiṣṭam,'nāha khalvayaṃ saṃpratyātmānaṃ jānātyayamahamasmīti no evemāni bhūtāni vināśamevāpīto bhavati nāhamatra bhogyaṃ paśyāmi' ityuktatvāt.
analyzed: nanu bhūmnaḥ priyasya ekatve asaṃvedya tvāt svarūpeṇa eva vā nitya saṃvedya tvāt nirviśeṣa tā iti na indrasya tat iṣṭam na āha khalu ayam saṃprati ātmānam jānāti ayam aham asmi iti no eva imāni bhūtāni vināśam eva api itas bhavati na aham atra bhogyam paśyāmi iti ukta tvāt

original: taddhi indrasyeṣṭam -- yadbhūtāni ca ātmānaṃ ca jānāti, na ca apriyaṃ kiṃcidvetti, sa sarvāṃśca lokānāpnoti sarvāṃśca kāmān yena jñānena. satyametadiṣṭamindrasya -- imāni bhūtāni matto'nyāni, lokāḥ kāmāśca sarve matto anye, ahameṣāṃ svāmīti. na tvetadindrasya hitam. hitaṃ ca indrasya prajāpatinā vaktavyam.
analyzed: tat hi indrasya iṣṭam yat bhūtāni ca ātmānam ca jānāti na ca apriyam kiṃcid vetti sa sarvān ca lokān āpnoti sarvān ca kāmān yena jñānena satyam etat iṣṭam indrasya imāni bhūtāni mattaḥ anyāni lokāḥ kāmāḥ ca sarve mattaḥ anye aham eṣām svāmī iti na tu etat indrasya hitam hitam ca indrasya prajāpatinā vaktavyam

original: vyomavadaśarīrātmatayā sarvabhūtalokakāmātmatvopagamena yā prāpti;, taddhitamindrāya vaktavyamiti prajāpatinā abhipretam. na tu rājño rājyāptivadanyatvena. tatraivaṃ sati kaṃ kena vijānīyādātmaikatve imāni bhūtānyayamahamasmīti. nanvasminpakṣe'strībhirvā yānairvā''sa yadi pitṛlokakāmaḥ''sa ekadhā bhavati' ityādyaiśvaryaśrutayo'nupapannāḥ;
analyzed: vyoma vat aśarīra ātmatayā sarva bhūta loka kāma ātmatva upagamena yā tat hitam indrāya vaktavyam iti prajāpatinā abhipretam na tu rājñaḥ rājya āpti vat anyatvena tatra evam sati kam kena vijānīyāt ātma ekatve imāni bhūtāni ayam aham asmi iti nanu asmin pakṣe strībhiḥ vā yānaiḥ vāsa yadi pitṛ loka kāmaḥ saḥ ekadhā bhavati iti ādi aiśvarya śrutayaḥ nupapannāḥ

original: na, sarvātmanaḥ sarvaphalasaṃbandhopapatteravirodhāt -- mṛda iva sarvaghaṭakarakakuṇḍādyāptiḥ. nanu sarvātmatve duḥkhasaṃbandho'pi syāditi cet, na duḥkhasyāpyātmatvopagamādavirodhaḥ. ātmanyavidyākalpanānimittāni duḥkhāni -- rajjvāmiva sarpādikalpanānimittāni.

original: sā ca avidyā aśarīrātmaikatvasvarūpadarśanena duḥkhanimittā ucchinneti duḥkhasaṃbandhāśaṅakā na saṃbhavati. śuddhasattvasaṃkalpanimittānāṃ tu kāmānām īśvaradehasaṃbandhaḥ sarvabhūteṣu mānasānām. para eva sarvasattvopādhidvāreṇa bhokteti sarvāvidyākṛtasaṃvyavahārāṇāṃ para eva ātmā āspadaṃ nānyo'stīti vedāntasiddhāntaḥ.
analyzed: sā ca avidyā aśarīra ātma ekatva svarūpa darśanena duḥkha nimittā ucchinnā iti duḥkha saṃbandha āśaṅakā na saṃbhavati śuddha sattva saṃkalpa nimittānām tu kāmānām īśvara deha saṃbandhaḥ sarva bhūteṣu mānasānām paraḥ eva sarva sattva upādhi dvāreṇa bhoktā iti sarva avidyā kṛta saṃvyavahārāṇām paraḥ eva ātmā āspadam na anyaḥ asti iti vedānta siddhāntaḥ

original: 'ya eṣo'kṣiṇi puruṣo dṛśyate' iti cchāyāpuruṣa eva prajāpatinā uktaḥ, svapnasuṣuptayośca anya eva, na paro'pahatapāpmatvādilakṣaṇaḥ, virodhāt iti kecinmanyante. chāyādyātmanāṃ ca upadeśe prayojanamācakṣate. ādāveva ucyamāne kila durvijñeyatvātparasya ātmanaḥ atyantabāhyaviṣayāsaktacetasaḥ atyantasūkṣmavastuśravaṇe vyāmoho mā bhūditi.
analyzed: yaḥ eṣa ukṣiṇi puruṣaḥ dṛśyate iti chāyāpuruṣaḥ eva prajāpatinā uktaḥ svapna suṣuptayoḥ ca anyaḥ eva na para upahata pāpma tva ādi lakṣaṇaḥ virodhāt iti kecid manyante chāyā ādi ātmanām ca upadeśe prayojanam ācakṣate ādau eva ucyamāne kila durvijñeya tvāt parasya ātmanaḥ atyanta bāhya viṣaya āsakta cetasaḥ atyanta sūkṣma vastu śravaṇe vyāmohaḥ mā bhūt iti

original: yathā kila dvitīyāyāṃ sūkṣmaṃ candraṃ didarśayiṣuḥ vṛkṣaṃ kaṃcitpratyakṣamādau darśayati -- paśya amumeṣa candra iti, tato'nyaṃ tato'pyanyaṃ girimūrdhānaṃ ca candrasamīpastham -- eṣa candra iti, tato'sau candraṃ paśyati, evametat'ya eṣo'kṣiṇi' ityādyuktaṃ prajāpatinā tribhiḥ paryāyaiḥ, na para iti.
analyzed: yathā kila dvitīyāyām sūkṣmam candram didarśayiṣuḥ vṛkṣam kaṃcid pratyakṣam ādau darśayati paśya amum eṣa candraḥ iti tatonyam tatas upi anyam giri mūrdhānam ca candra samīpa stham eṣa candraḥ iti tatas asau candram paśyati evam etatyaḥ eṣa ukṣiṇi ityādi uktam prajāpatinā tribhiḥ paryāyaiḥ na paraḥ iti

original: caturthe tu paryāye dehānmartyātsamutthāya aśarīratāmāpanno jyotiḥsvarūpam. yasminnuttamapuruṣe stryādibhirjakṣatkrīḍannamamāṇo bhavati, sa uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ para ukta iti ca āhuḥ. satyam, ramaṇīyā tāvadiyaṃ vyākhyā śrotum. na tu artho'sya granthasya evaṃ saṃbhavati.
analyzed: caturthe tu paryāye dehāt martyāt samutthāya aśarīra tām āpannaḥ jyotiḥ svarūpam yasmin uttama puruṣe strī ādibhiḥ jakṣat krīḍat namamāṇaḥ bhavati saḥ uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ paraḥ uktaḥ iti ca āhuḥ satyam ramaṇīyā tāvat iyam vyākhyā śrotum na tu arthaḥ asya granthasya evam saṃbhavati

original: katham?'akṣiṇi puruṣo dṛśyate' ityupanyasya śiṣyābhyāṃ chāyātmani gṛhīte tayostadviparītagrahaṇaṃ matvā tadapanayāya udaśarāvopanyāsaḥ'kiṃ paśyathaḥ' iti ca praśnaḥ sādhvalaṃkāropadeśaśca anarthakaḥ syāt, yadi chāyātmaiva prajāpatinā'akṣiṇi dṛśyate' ityupadiṣṭaḥ. kiṃca yadi svayamupadiṣṭa iti grahaṇasyāpyapanayanakāraṇaṃ vaktavyaṃ syāt.
analyzed: katham akṣiṇi puruṣaḥ dṛśyate iti upanyasya śiṣyābhyām chāyā ātmani gṛhīte tayoḥ tad viparīta grahaṇam matvā tad apanayāya uda śarāva upanyāsaḥ kim paśyathaḥ iti ca praśnaḥ sādhu alaṃkāra upadeśaḥ ca anarthakaḥ syāt yadi chāyā ātmā eva prajāpatinā akṣiṇi dṛśyate iti upadiṣṭaḥ kiṃca yadi svayam upadiṣṭaḥ iti grahaṇasya api apanayana kāraṇam vaktavyam syāt

original: svapnasuṣuptātmagrahaṇayorapi tadapanayakāraṇaṃ ca svayaṃ brūyāt. na ca uktam. tena manyāmahe na akṣiṇi cchāyātmā prajāpatinā upadiṣṭaḥ. kiṃ cānyat, akṣiṇi draṣṭā cet'dṛśyate' ityupadiṣṭaḥ syāt, tata idaṃ yuktam.'etaṃ tveva te' ityuktvā svapne'pi draṣṭurevopadeśaḥ. svapne na draṣṭopadiṣṭa iti cet, na,'api roditīva''apriyavetteva' ityupadeśāt.
analyzed: svapna suṣupta ātma grahaṇayoḥ api tad apanaya kāraṇam ca svayam brūyāt na ca uktam tena manyāmahe na akṣiṇi chāyā ātmā prajāpatinā upadiṣṭaḥ kim ca anyat akṣiṇi draṣṭā ced dṛśyate iti upadiṣṭaḥ syāt tatas idam yuktam etam tu eva te iti uktvā svapne pi draṣṭuḥ eva upadeśaḥ svapne na draṣṭā upadiṣṭaḥ iti ced na api roditi iva apriya vettā iva iti upadeśāt

original: na ca draṣṭuranyaḥ kaścitsvapne mahīyamānaścarati.'annāyaṃ puruṣaḥ svayaṃjyotiḥ' iti nyāyataḥ śrutyantare siddhatvāt. yadyapi svapne sadhīrbhavati, tathāpi na dhīḥ svapnabhogopalabdhiṃ prati karaṇatvaṃ bhajate. kiṃ tarhi, paṭacitravajjāgradvāsanāśrayā dṛśyaiva dhīrbhavatīti na draṣṭuḥ svayaṃjyotiṣṭvabādhaḥ syāt.

original: kiṃcānyat, jāgratsvapnayorbhūtāni ca ātmānaṃ ca jānāti -- imāni bhūtānyayamahamasmīti. prāptau satyāṃ pratiṣedho yuktaḥ syāt -- nāha khalvayamityādi.

original: tathā cetanasyaiva avidyānimittayoḥ saśarīratve sati priyāpriyayorapahatirnāstītyuktvā tasyaivāśarīrasya sato vidyāyāṃ satyāṃ saśarīratve prāptayoḥ pratiṣedho yuktaḥ'aśarīraṃ vāva santaṃ na priyāpriye spṛśataḥ' iti. ekaścātmā svapnabuddhāntayormahāmatsyavadasaṅagaḥ saṃcaratīti śrutyantare siddham.
analyzed: tathā cetanasya eva avidyā nimittayoḥ sa śarīra tve sati priya apriyayoḥ apahatiḥ na asti iti uktvā tasya eva aśarīrasya sataḥ vidyāyām satyām sa śarīra tve prāptayoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ yuktaḥ aśarīram vāva santam na priya apriye spṛśataḥ iti ekaḥ ca ātmā svapna buddha antayoḥ mahā matsya vat asaṅagaḥ saṃcarati iti śruti antare siddham

original: yaccoktaṃ saṃprasādaḥ śarīrātsamutthāya yasminstryādibhiḥ ramamāṇo bhavati so'nyaḥ saṃprasādādadhikaraṇanirdiṣṭa uttamaḥ puruṣa iti, tadapyasat. caturthe'pi paryāye'etaṃ tveva te' iti vacanāt. yadi tato'nyo'bhipretaḥ syāt, pūrvavat'etaṃ tveva te' iti na brūyānmṛṣā prajāpatiḥ.
analyzed: yat ca uktam saṃprasādaḥ śarīrāt samutthāya yasmin strī ādibhiḥ ramamāṇaḥ bhavati saḥ anyaḥ saṃprasādāt adhikaraṇa nirdiṣṭaḥ uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ iti tat api asat caturthe api paryāye etam tu eva te iti vacanāt yadi tatonyaḥ abhipretaḥ syāt pūrvavat itam tu eva te iti na brūyāt mṛṣā prajāpatiḥ

original: kiṃcānyat, tejobannādīnāṃ sraṣṭuḥ sataḥ svavikāradehaśuṅage praveśaṃ darśayitvā praviṣṭāya punaḥ tattvamasītyupadeśaḥ mṛṣā prasajyeta. tasmiṃstvaṃ stryādibhiḥ rantā bhaviṣyasīti yukta upadeśo'bhaviṣyat yadi saṃprasādādanya uttamaḥ puruṣo bhavet.
